videos.title: Pilates
videos.description: The narrator sheds light on innovative and safe form of physical exercise called Pilates, which helps in strengthening the core, toning up muscles and obtaining a lean body.

videos.title: Namaste Yoga
videos.description: Learn to stay open, no matter what happens, with the Root to Rise sequence. This practice provides an opportunity to explore your capacity for receiving energy, while building strength and confidence. When you maintain a connection to grounded energy, you can heighten your ability to stay present in every moment.

videos.title: Big Little Footprints
videos.description: We visit an island resort in Fiji known for its daring shark encounters to hear and see the conservation work they're doing. Along the way we meet local school children, and learn about how they're helping protect the reef.

videos.title: Big Little Footprints
videos.description: Fiji is an idyllic island in the South Pacific, known for its coral reef and chance to swim with giant Manta Rays. We visit the local village to learn about its important relationship with the resort.

videos.title: Big Little Footprints
videos.description: Today, we travel to Australia's favorite playground, the Gold Coast, to prove family vacations can have it all. Fun and education. Beach and the rainforest. Roller coasters and wildlife. A destination both beautiful and fun.

videos.title: Big Little Footprints
videos.description: From cute koalas to the world heritage Great Barrier Reef, this family tick off seeing two of Australia's biggest icons, learn about their vulnerability and how tourists can help.
